notes.title: Scrapbook Update
notes.content:
[p]New demo update is out now![/p][p][/p][p]The main new thing we've added this time is scrapbooking. You can now turn the photos you've taken into stickers and arrange them in a customizable scrapbook, along with art stickers and washi tape. [/p][p][/p][p]We're continuing to add to this system and would love to hear your feedback. The long-term plan is allowing players to make books (multiple pages, text etc).  [/p][p][/p][p]We've also squashed a few bugs, and probably made some new ones (｀∀´)Ψ   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44690595/68d0a991dfdd64ffc2bb72952f3b761f31d34c1a.png"][/img][/p][p]In other news, we're excited to be taking part in the Back To School Games Celebration on Steam (August 25 - Sept 1st), which showcases games themed around school, study or creativity. Check it out here:
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025[/url]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[p]New demo is out now![/p][p][/p][p]We've added some new features, re-balanced old ones and included a more obvious warning about the unstable nature of demo data (˵ ¬ᴗ¬˵) We hope you enjoy this early glimpse at Soggy Beans <3[/p][p][/p][p]Tag us on Bluesky if you post things (@ratmode.games) and if you have thoughts to share or bugs to report, please let us know via either our Discord or this form: [url="https://forms.gle/BK59U3qMaVPPJZZTA"]https://forms.gle/BK59U3qMaVPPJZZTA[/url]  

If you're a content creator and want to be considered for future friendship things, here's a form: [url="https://forms.gle/8enyuy4M7XbT5mZj6"]https://forms.gle/8enyuy4M7XbT5mZj6[/url]  Thanks for supporting our lil fish game! 🐟[/p][p][/p][p]We're also stoked to be apart of Frosty Games Fest, which features a bunch of other very cool demos from ANZ, be sure to check those out too! and Steam Next Fest. June is busy!! AAAAHhesifnerjskg[/p]
